title: Naolys takes root in India
summary: Naolys announces a new strategic partnership in India with Greenflo Bioactives, opening its living biotechnologies to one of the world’s fastest-growing beauty markets

extraction.key_fact: 나올리스가 그린플로 바이오액티브스와 전략적 파트너십을 체결하고 인도 뷰티 시장에 진출한다.
